description: Bazel, npm, and gem dependencies come from upstream Sorbet and are updated when syncing with it, so Renovate only updates what scip-ruby owns.

packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates once checks pass; major updates need review.
Update Ruby in .ruby-version, the Docker base image, and setup-ruby together, as in #274. Ruby patch releases get their own PR, so a newer Ruby minor doesn't hide them.

A Ruby minor version changes the Ruby that auto-indexing runs bundle install with, and CI doesn't build the Docker images, so it needs review. Its own group keeps it from holding back the Ruby group's auto-merge.
This upstream workflow only runs in Shopify/sorbet.
